texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER PESTICIDE / FOLIAR SPRAYING - Reina Mercedes: pesticide, fungicide, herbicide, and foliar application should be deferred. texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — San Agustin: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. DEFER basal and top-dress fertilizer application until 2–3 dry days are observed. Consider split-application strategy when conditions improve. For critical growth stages, consult AEW/MAO before proceeding.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not apply fertilizer today due to rain risk. Wait 2-3 dry days. Less waste, better yield.
texts.lgu:

texts.bulletin: SPRAYING ADVISORY — San Agustin: Do not apply pesticides or foliar fertilizers in rainy conditions.
